title: Custom renderer view
description: The data of component 'custom' (envelope paneweft.view/2). A repo-owned renderer is named by id, API version and digests; the payload is validated against the locally registered renderer schema (no network schema loading); a standard-component fallback is REQUIRED so agents and humans can always read the same facts.

objects.description: Object ids the renderer may name in select_item and open_object. Anything else is refused by the host.
